Message.Name: Login Message
Message.Description: The Login message is the first message sent to the Spin Server by a user's process after the connection to the Spin Server is established. Failure to login before sending any other message type will result in the connection being dropped by the Spin Server. The format of the Login message for the Spin Server is identical to that of the GRP.

Field.Name: SessionSubId
Field.Description: SessionSubId supplied by Cboe.

Field.Name: Username
Field.Description: Username supplied by Cboe.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: (space filled)

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password supplied by Cboe.

Message.Name: Login Response Message
Message.Description: The Login Response message is sent by the Spin Server to a user's process in response to a Login message. The status field is used to reflect an accepted login or the reason the session was not accepted. If login fails, the connection will be dropped after the Login Response message is sent.

Field.Name: Login Response Status
Field.Description: Accepted or reason for reject. A = Login accepted, N = Not authorized (invalid username/password), B = Session in use, S = Invalid session.

Message.Name: Spin Image Available Message
Message.Description: The Spin Image Available message is sent once per second and indicates through what sequence number a spin is available.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Spin is available which is current through this sequence number.

Message.Name: Spin Request Message
Message.Description: The Spin Request message is used by a user's process to request transmission of a spin of the unit's order book.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Sequence number from a Spin Image Available message received by the member.

Message.Name: Spin Response Message
Message.Description: The Spin Response message is sent in response to a user's Spin Request message indicating whether a spin will be sent.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Sequence number from a Spin Image Available message received by the member.

Field.Name: Order Count
Field.Description: Number of Add Order messages which will be contained in this spin.

Field.Name: Spin Response Status
Field.Description: Accepted or reason for reject. All non-A status codes should be interpreted as a reject. A = Accepted, O = Out of range, S = Spin already in process.

Message.Name: Spin Finished Message
Message.Description: The Spin Finished message is sent to indicate that all messages for the spin requested have been sent. A Spin Finished message is only sent if a Spin Request was not rejected. Upon receipt of a Spin Finished message, any buffered multicast messages should be applied to the member's copy of the book to make it current.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Sequence number from the Spin Request message.

Message.Name: Instrument Definition Request Message
Message.Description: The Instrument Definition Request message is used by a user's process to request transmission of this unit's Symbol Mappings and Complex Instrument Definitions. Included for consistency with the Options Spin Server; not typically used on Equities feeds.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Must be 0. Only the current Symbol Mappings and Complex Instrument Definitions are available.

Message.Name: Instrument Definition Response Message
Message.Description: The Instrument Definition Response message is sent in response to a user's Instrument Definition Request message indicating whether a spin will be sent.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Will always be 0.

Field.Name: Instrument Count
Field.Description: Number of Symbol Mapping and Complex Instrument Definition messages (if applicable) which will be contained in this spin.

Field.Name: Instrument Definition Response Status
Field.Description: Accepted or reason for reject. All non-A status codes should be interpreted as a reject. A = Accepted, O = Out of range, S = Spin already in process.

Message.Name: Instrument Definition Finished Message
Message.Description: The Instrument Definition Finished message is sent to indicate that all Symbol Mapping and Complex Instrument Definition messages for this unit have been sent. An Instrument Definition Finished message is only sent if an Instrument Definition Request was not rejected.

Message.Name: Time Message
Message.Description: A Time message is immediately generated and sent when there is a PITCH event for a given clock second. If there is no PITCH event for a given clock second, then no Time message is sent for that second. The Time field is the number of seconds relative to midnight Eastern Time. All subsequent time offset fields for the same unit will use the new Time message value as the base until another Time message is received for the same unit.

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds elapsed since the start of the current Eastern Time calendar day, derived by converting the current Eastern wall clock time (HH:MM:SS) to seconds.

Message.Name: Unit Clear Message
Message.Description: The Unit Clear message instructs feed recipients to clear all orders for the Cboe book in the unit specified in the Sequenced Unit Header message. For Equities only, this message will be sent at startup each day. It would also be distributed in certain recovery events such as a data center fail-over.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Message.Name: Add Order Long Message
Message.Description: An Add Order message represents a newly accepted visible order on the Cboe book. It includes a day-specific Order Id assigned by Cboe to the order.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy Order, S = Sell Order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts being added to the book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price.

Field.Name: Add Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 - Reserved (set to 1). Bits 1-2 - Reserved. Bit 3 - AON (Options only, 0 = Order is a firm quote, 1 = Order is AON). Bits 4-7 - Reserved.

Message.Name: Add Order Short Message
Message.Description: An Add Order message represents a newly accepted visible order on the Cboe book. It includes a day-specific Order Id assigned by Cboe to the order.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy Order, S = Sell Order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts being added to the book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price.

Field.Name: Add Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 - Reserved (set to 1). Bits 1-2 - Reserved. Bit 3 - AON (Options only, 0 = Order is a firm quote, 1 = Order is AON). Bits 4-7 - Reserved.

Message.Name: Add Order Expanded Message
Message.Description: The expanded version of the Add Order message has been made available to accommodate larger symbol sizes possible through the ISRA plan.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy Order, S = Sell Order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts being added to the book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price.

Field.Name: Add Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 - Reserved (set to 1). Bits 1-2 - Reserved. Bit 3 - AON (Options only). Bits 4-7 - Reserved.

Field.Name: ParticipantID
Field.Description: Optionally specified. If specified, the MPID (equities) of firm attributed to this quote. Alternatively "RTAL" for retail specified orders (equities). Space filled otherwise.

Field.Name: Customer Indicator
Field.Description: Space filled on all equities markets. R = Retail Priority order (EDGX Equities only).

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: Order Executed messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is executed in whole or in part. The execution price equals the limit order price found in the original Add Order message or the limit order price in the latest Modify Order message referencing the Order Id.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that was executed.

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts executed.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Message.Name: Order Executed at Price Size Message
Message.Description: Order Executed at Price/Size messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is executed in whole or in part at a different price than the limit price on the original Add Order message or the limit order price in the latest Modify Order message referencing the Order Id. If the Remaining Quantity field contains a 0 the order should be completely removed from the book.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that was executed.

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts executed.

Field.Name: Remaining Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts remaining after the execution.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order.

Message.Name: Reduce Size Long Message
Message.Description: Reduce Size messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is partially reduced.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been reduced.

Field.Name: Canceled Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts canceled.

Message.Name: Reduce Size Short Message
Message.Description: Reduce Size messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is partially reduced.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been reduced.

Field.Name: Canceled Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts canceled.

Message.Name: Modify Order Long Message
Message.Description: The Modify Order message is sent whenever an open order is visibly modified. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message. Note that Modify Order messages that appear to be "No Ops" (i.e. they do not appear to modify any relevant fields) will still lose priority.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been modified.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts associated with this order after this modify (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price after this modify.

Field.Name: Modify Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 - Display (0 = Order is not aggregated in the Cboe SIP quote, 1 = Order is aggregated in the Cboe SIP quote). Bit 1 - Maintain Priority (0 = Reset Priority, 1 = Maintain Priority). Bits 2-7 - Reserved.

Message.Name: Modify Order Short Message
Message.Description: The Modify Order message is sent whenever an open order is visibly modified. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been modified.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts associated with this order after this modify (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price after this modify.

Field.Name: Modify Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 - Display (0 = Order is not aggregated in the Cboe SIP quote, 1 = Order is aggregated in the Cboe SIP quote). Bit 1 - Maintain Priority (0 = Reset Priority, 1 = Maintain Priority). Bits 2-7 - Reserved.

Message.Name: Delete Order Message
Message.Description: The Delete Order message is sent whenever a booked order is cancelled or leaves the order book. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message. An order that is deleted from the book may return to the book later under certain circumstances. Therefore, a Delete Order message does not indicate that a given Order Id will not be sent again on a subsequent Add Order message.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been removed from order book.

Message.Name: Trade Long Message
Message.Description: The Trade message provides information about executions of non-displayed orders on the Cboe book and routed executions to other trading centers. Trade messages are necessary to calculate Cboe execution-based data. Trade messages do not alter the book and can be ignored if messages are being used solely to build a book.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Obfuscated Order ID or Order Id of the executed order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always B = Buy Order regardless of resting side.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Incremental number of shares/contracts executed.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Message.Name: Trade Short Message
Message.Description: The Trade message provides information about executions of non-displayed orders on the Cboe book and routed executions to other trading centers.

Field.Name: Order Id

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Message.Name: Trade Break Message
Message.Description: The Trade Break message is sent whenever an execution on Cboe is broken. Trade breaks are rare and only affect applications that rely upon Cboe execution-based data. Applications that simply build a Cboe book can ignore Trade Break messages.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe execution identifier of the execution that was broken. Execution Id refers to previously sent Order Executed or Trade message.

Message.Name: End of Session Message
Message.Description: The End of Session message is sent for each unit when the unit shuts down. No more sequenced messages will be delivered for this unit, but heartbeats from the unit may be received.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Message.Name: Trading Status Message
Message.Description: The Trading Status message is used to indicate the current trading status of a security. A Trading Status message will be sent whenever a security's trading status changes. Trading Status of S is to be implied at system startup for all symbols. Sequenced Trading Status messages are sent upon system start up for all active securities with Trading Status = 'S' (suspended). Trading Status messages will continue to be published upon symbol state changes, such as at the beginning of order acceptance.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: A = Accepting Orders for Queuing (Equities only), H = Halted, Q = Quote-Only, S = Exchange Specific Suspension, T = Trading.

Field.Name: Reg SHO Action
Field.Description: 0 = No price test in effect, 1 = Reg SHO price test restriction in effect.

Field.Name: Reserved1
Field.Description: Reserved.

Field.Name: Reserved2
Field.Description: Reserved.

Message.Name: Auction Update Message
Message.Description: BYX and BZX Equities Only. Auction Update messages are used to disseminate Cboe price and size information during auctions for Cboe listed securities and for Cboe Market Close (CMC) crosses on BZX, and for Periodic Auctions on BYX. This is the BZX Equities layout (Table 31).

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: O = Opening Auction, C = Closing Auction, H = Halt Auction, I = IPO Auction, M = Cboe Market Close.

Field.Name: Reference Price
Field.Description: BBO Collared auction price. Shares matched for Cboe Market Close.

Field.Name: Buy Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares on buy side at the Reference Price. Shares matched for Cboe Market Close.

Field.Name: Sell Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares on sell side at the Reference Price. Shares matched for Cboe Market Close.

Field.Name: Indicative Price
Field.Description: Price at which the auction book and the continuous book would match.

Field.Name: Auction Only Price
Field.Description: Price at which the auction book would match using only Eligible Auction Orders.

Message.Name: Auction Summary Message
Message.Description: BYX Equities, BZX Equities, and Options Only. Auction Summary messages are used to disseminate the results of an auction of a Cboe listed security on BZX, the results of an Opening or Re-Opening of any options series on C1, and for Periodic Auctions on BYX. An Auction Summary message will be sent for Cboe Market Close (CMC) once the official closing price for each security is available.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: C = Closing Auction, H = Halt Auction, I = IPO Auction, M = Cboe Market Close, P = Periodic Auction (BYX Only).

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Auction price or CMC match price.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Cumulative number of shares/contracts executed during the auction or CMC matching.

Message.Name: Retail Price Improvement Message
Message.Description: BYX and (effective 04/10/26) EDGX Only. The Retail Price Improvement message is a Retail Liquidity Indicator (RLI) that includes symbol and side, but not price and size. An RLI will be disseminated when there is a Retail Price Improving (RPI) order present for a symbol on the Exchange order book OR to indicate a RPI order is no longer available. Cboe will disseminate a Retail Price Improvement message when the resting RPI order is priced better than the NBBO.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Retail Price Improvement
Field.Description: B = Buy Side RPI, S = Sell Side RPI, A = Buy and Sell RPI, N = No RPI.

Bitfield.Name: Add Flags
Bitfield.Description: Add Flags bit field used in Add Order messages. Bit 0 is reserved and set to 1. Bit 3 (AON) is Options only.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Bits 0-2 Reserved (Bit 0 set to 1).

Field.Name: AON
Field.Description: Options only. 0 = Order is a firm quote, 1 = Order is AON (All or None).

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Bits 4-7 Reserved.

Bitfield.Name: Modify Flags
Bitfield.Description: Modify Flags bit field used in Modify Order messages.

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: Bit 0 - Display. 0 = Order is not aggregated in the Cboe SIP quote, 1 = Order is aggregated in the Cboe SIP quote.

Field.Name: Maintain Priority
Field.Description: Bit 1 - Maintain Priority. 0 = Reset Priority, 1 = Maintain Priority.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Bits 2-7 Reserved.
